finding.actual58Attribution: UNCONFIRMED: no exact raw traceback or complete hash reconstruction matches the 1544-byte Mac log. Similar line/byte lengths are not proof.
facts: Stock mach python launches the chosen virtualenv Python with command_context.run_process. Registrar Python objects in the parent Mach process do not transfer to this fresh interpreter.

The new interpreter successfully imports runxpcshelltests, parser_desktop, MozbuildObject, BuildDriver, LoggingManager and StructuredLogger using the fixed mach/common source paths, but its actual Registrar.categories remains empty.

Inventory then executes the entire stock testing/xpcshell/mach_commands.py. Its actual @Command xpcshell-test registration names category testing. _MachCommand.register calls Registrar.register_command_handler, which raises MachError when that category is absent.

The same complete stock module imports successfully when the category is first registered through the real Registrar API. The synthetic module name remains absent from sys.modules in both cases; missing sys.modules registration is not the cause of this reproduced error.
finding.fixedExceptionMessage: Cannot register a command to an undefined category: xpcshell-test -> testing
finding.impact: Reproducible startup defect in the standalone child import path; a leading source explanation for the observed inventory nonzero exit, not direct identification of the lost Mac exception.

minimalProposedInitialization.absentCategory: Use the real Registrar API once, then assert exact tuple metadata and the expected commands_by_category set entry.
minimalProposedInitialization.definitionRead: Bind the fixed file by hash and bounded owned/no-follow source reading, extract only the single literal CATEGORIES assignment, and require exact known testing metadata/types. Avoid importing mach_initialize merely to get the dictionary: its module tail installs a sys.meta_path finder hook.
minimalProposedInitialization.existingCategory: Require type tuple, length 3, exact str/str/int types with int not bool, and exact equality to the stock metadata tuple. Require the category membership container to be a set. Preserve its identity and contents; do not call register_category again.
minimalProposedInitialization.mismatch: Fail with a fixed privacy-safe initialization/binding code; do not silently overwrite an existing foreign/malformed category or weaken the decorator check.
minimalProposedInitialization.normalStockCaller: mach_initialize.initialize iterates CATEGORIES and calls driver.define_category(name, short, long, priority). Mach.define_category forwards to Registrar.register_category.
minimalProposedInitialization.qualification: A normal command-registry initialization step before full stock module execution; no skipping or monkeypatching stock @Command and no test/selection changes.
minimalProposedInitialization.state: Proposal only. Root owns implementation, repository regression tests, source publication and any later actual-Mac admission.
minimalProposedInitialization.whyNoOverwrite: Actual Registrar.register_category unconditionally resets commands_by_category[name] to an empty set, so re-registering an existing category discards its command membership list.

normalSiteAnalysis.default: Mach command contexts with no explicit virtualenv use MozbuildObject._virtualenv_name = virtualenv_name or common. The python command ensures that context virtualenv and runs its Python executable.
normalSiteAnalysis.explicitCommon: mach python --virtualenv common chooses the same logical site and does not initialize Registrar categories. It is not a repair for this reproduced defect.
normalSiteAnalysis.limits: Linux import-path reproduction is not actual Mac Mach/bootstrap or mozinfo/listing validation. Optional installed packages and runtime metadata may differ.
normalSiteAnalysis.machOnly: The isolated mach-only path additionally lacks redo imported by mozcrash. This is a separate site-scope observation, not the current common-context Mac cause.
normalSiteAnalysis.noPipOrVenvWork: This review reconstructed the declared first-party/vendored import paths in isolated Linux Python. It did not create/activate/ensure a Mach virtualenv, execute a Mach command, install requirements, contact a package index or build anything.
normalSiteAnalysis.ordinaryXpcshellCommand: The stock xpcshell-test @Command declares no dedicated virtualenv. The actual Mach initialize path defines all categories before normal command dispatch.
